dialogues.speaker: Marine
dialogues.text: Hey-ho, Boss, Proto-Boss, how's the situation? If the monsters have all been dealt with, I'll get back to my business!

choices.text: I think there's still some left...

response.speaker: Marine
response.text: Alright then, I guess I'll stay here on standby.

response.speaker: Marine
response.text: If you get tired, let me know. I can always hop back on the cannon while you take a rest.

response.speaker: Marine
response.text: I could shoot those monsters all day.

choices.text: Are you not going to talk to the other two?

response.speaker: Marine
response.text: Huh? I've already talked to them at length.

response.speaker: Marine
response.text: Miss Chenee gave me a very valuable dessert — a type of cake I've never tried before. By human standards, I think it should be considered delicious.

response.speaker: Marine
response.text: My tastes have already been "tamed" by my colleagues, so I found it quite enjoyable too.

response.speaker: Marine
response.text: Chenee must come from a rich family, while Frejus comes from humbler origins. She's always giving him desserts like that — she must spend eight or nine thousand Mora a day on them.

response.speaker: Marine
response.text: Guesswork. You can tell a lot by the way people walk, their facial expressions, and the words they use.

response.speaker: Marine
response.text: The first time I took a rest alongside them, I felt like I wasn't supposed to be there. Not that they resented my presence, but something about the atmosphere didn't feel quite right...

response.speaker: Marine
response.text: So, I've decided not to disturb them. Besides, standing guard quietly over here suits me just fine — I used to do a lot of reconnaissance and sentry duty when I was in the force.

choices.text: You have other business to attend to?

response.speaker: Marine
response.text: Yes, I was only in the area by chance after taking a mission from Edl— another agent.

response.speaker: Marine
response.text: Lately, a group of white-collar crooks has been spotted around here.

response.speaker: Marine
response.text: And it just so happens that there are quite a few houses up for rent in the area, so I thought I'd come and look for clues.

response.speaker: Marine
response.text: But I have to admit, investigating financial crimes isn't anywhere near as exciting as blasting monsters to bits.

response.speaker: Marine
response.text: If you ever need anyone to help you pummel some monsters, I'll be up for it. Obviously, it would be best if meals were included, but if they're not, I can always bring my own.

choices.text: I'll get back to dealing with the monsters.

response.speaker: Marine
response.text: Lots of work left to do, I see. That's great. If you find yourself getting tired, let me know, and I can take care of the cannon blasting for you.

dialogues.speaker: Marine
dialogues.text: I was just wondering... Do you have any more interesting food ideas? You really piqued my interest with that "Fonta-Fermented Tidalga."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? So you're a fan of mystery-box fine dining, too?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How about... "Apple Cider Tidalga", or "Coffee Tidalga," or... or... "Jueyun Chili Tidalga"? As long as it isn't poisonous, you could try pretty much anything!
